stem: A telemetry group is selecting a new time-series platform in 2026 and must avoid closed-to-new-customer guidance while choosing current options. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Standardize on Timestream for LiveAnalytics for all new customer onboarding.
Treat Timestream for LiveAnalytics as closed to new customers during solution selection.
Evaluate Timestream for InfluxDB as a current alternative for similar capabilities.
Standardize on a transactional relational instance as the primary high-ingest time-series platform.
Standardize on a key-value primary table for every time-series query pattern without evaluating specialized options.

rationale: The service-status guidance says Timestream for LiveAnalytics is closed to new customers and recommends evaluating Timestream for InfluxDB for similar capabilities. Selecting LiveAnalytics for new-customer onboarding conflicts with that status. Transactional relational and pure key-value defaults can be useful in some contexts but are not the direct closed-service replacement strategy asked for here.
